# bioexcel/biobb_amber/cpptraj_randomize_ions

## Summary

Wrapper of the AmberTools (AMBER MD Package) cpptraj tool module.

Swap specified ions with randomly selected solvent molecules using cpptraj tool from the AmberTools MD package.

Nextflow adapter of the [CpptrajRandomizeIons](https://biobb-amber.readthedocs.io/en/latest/cpptraj.html#module-cpptraj.cpptraj_randomize_ions) building block of [biobb_amber](https://github.com/bioexcel/biobb_amber) 5.3.3.

## Get started

```nextflow
include { BIOBB_AMBER_CPPTRAJ_RANDOMIZE_IONS } from 'bioexcel/biobb_amber/cpptraj_randomize_ions'

workflow {
    BIOBB_AMBER_CPPTRAJ_RANDOMIZE_IONS(ch_input)
}
```

Optional input files are passed as `[]`.

## Inputs

| Name | Required | Formats | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `meta` | yes | | Map with at least an `id` key, used as tag and output file prefix |
| `input_top_path` | yes | top, parmtop, prmtop | Input topology file (AMBER ParmTop) |
| `input_crd_path` | yes | crd, mdcrd, inpcrd | Input coordinates file (AMBER crd) |

## Outputs

Each output channel emits `[meta, file]`. Files are named `<prefix>_<role>.<extension>`, where role is the output argument without `output_` and `_path`.
Optional outputs are only produced if requested in `ext.outputs`.

| Channel | Required | Formats (default first) | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `output_pdb_path` | yes | pdb | Structure PDB file with randomized ions |
| `output_crd_path` | yes | crd, mdcrd, inpcrd | Structure CRD file with coordinates including randomized ions |
| `versions_biobb_amber` | yes | | `[process, 'biobb_amber', version]`, also sent to the `versions` topic |

## Configuration

Set with `ext` in a `process` `withName` selector:

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `ext.properties` | Map of CpptrajRandomizeIons properties (see below). Defaults: `[can_write_file_log: false]` |
| `ext.outputs` | Map of output argument to extension, for example `[output_pdb_path: 'pdb']`. Required outputs use their first format by default; optional outputs are only requested when listed here |
| `ext.prefix` | Output file prefix (default: `meta.id`) |

`raise_error` and `restart` are always set by the adapter: failed commands fail the task, and `-resume` replaces restart.
Do not set the `container_*` properties: Nextflow runs the task inside the biobb_amber container.

```groovy
process {
    withName: 'BIOBB_AMBER_CPPTRAJ_RANDOMIZE_IONS' {
        ext.properties = [ion_mask: ':K+,Cl-,Na+']
    }
}
```

### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ion_mask` | string | ":K+,Cl-,Na+" | Ions to be randomized. Cpptraj mask syntax can be found at the official Cpptraj manual. |
| `solute_mask` | string | ":DA,DC,DG,DT,D?3,D?5" | Solute (or set of atoms) around which the ions can get no closer than the distance specified. Cpptraj mask syntax can be found at the official Cpptraj manual. |
| `distance` | number | 5.0 | Minimum distance cutoff for the ions around the defined solute. |
| `overlap` | number | 3.5 | Minimum distance between ions. |
| `binary_path` | string | "cpptraj" | Path to the cpptraj executable binary. |
| `remove_tmp` | boolean | true | Remove temporal files. |
| `sandbox_path` | string | "./" | Parent path to the sandbox directory. |
